answer.content: [p. 2] A GEO satellite is a type of satellite that orbits the Earth at a geostationary orbit (GEO), staying above one point on the Earth's surface, such as the equator. [p. 2] Example: Three GEO satellites cover the entire Earth, used for TV and weather broadcasts.
